category_note: REAL_ANIMAL are ordinary working animals. AETHERKIN are original alchemical creatures; no borrowed bestiary names remain.

lab_rat.description: Keen-nosed and unimpressed. Learns a maze faster than most interns learn the SDS.

enhanced_lab_rat.description: A rat with a subcutaneous telemetry chip; its stress response is a real toxicity readout.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Live toxicity telemetry during dosing studies

lab_cat.description: Sleeps on the fume hood, wakes for solvent vapours and strangers.

lab_dog.description: Trained on three odour signatures and stubbornly loyal to all of them.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Warns before you enter a contaminated room

carrier_pigeon.description: A living sample courier. Temperature-sensitive and utterly unimpressed by weather.

gecko.description: Sticks to glassware cupboards and eats the insects you did not know were there.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Catches fungal and insect contamination early

axolotl.description: Regenerates limbs and, in this lab, your confidence in vertebrate models.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Once per session, a failed protocol is not fatal to the batch

raven.description: Steals labels, remembers faces, and has strong opinions about your handwriting.

cinderling.description: A palm-sized ember that nests in burner cones. It eats soot and sulks when the flame is too lean.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Cuts heat damage by 20% and steadies a flame

brinejack.description: A crab-like scavenger with salt crystals on its shell. Drinks brine and spits distilled water.

glasswing_moth.description: Wings of silica scale so thin they show Newton's rings. It lands on cracks and refuses to move.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Detects microfractures in glassware before they fail
UV inspection improves crystal purity checks

calcine_hound.description: An ash-grey canid with furnace breath. Tracks residues by their thermal signature.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Follows a residue trail across the facility
Shrugs off radiant heat near furnaces

mercurial_ferret.description: Its fur flows like liquid metal. It can round up a mercury spill into a single bright bead.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Recovers spilled reagents instead of losing them
Safe handling of mercury and heavy-metal spills

lumen_eel.description: A ribbon of cold light in a dark tank. Its glow tracks reactive oxygen species.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Restores stamina faster during long protocols

verdant_sloth.description: Moss grows in its fur in the exact pattern of its last meal. It moves once an hour, decisively.

obsidian_beetle.description: Its carapace is a natural radiation shield. It walks toward the source, which is the problem.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Reduces fire and arc-flash damage by 35%
Shields against beta and low-energy gamma

null_moth.description: It feeds on static. Balances settle in its presence, and so do your nerves.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Prevents solvent-vapour ignition from static discharge

tideglass_serpent.description: Swims through microgravity water without surface tension. Its scales nucleate crystals on command.

auric_kite.description: A paper-thin raptor that circles anything conductive. Its feathers ring faintly near gold.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Locates noble-metal residues and ore traces

sable_lynx.description: A shadow with eyes. It sees heat, hears lies, and dislikes being photographed.

halide_newt.description: Its skin changes colour with halogen concentration. A living indicator paper with opinions.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Halide and halogen sensing in the fume hood
Early warning for chlorine and bromine leaks

xenon_owl.description: It hunts vacuum leaks by sound. Its eyes are the colour of a discharge tube.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Locates vacuum leaks and noble-gas contamination

prism_finch.description: Its plumage splits light across a spectrum. It can tell two nearly identical yellows apart.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Colour-based purity grading at a glance

ferro_snail.description: Its shell is a magnetic lattice. It hoovers iron nanoparticles off glass without scratching.

ember_drake.description: A furnace with wings. Bonding one is less a capture and more a negotiated ceasefire.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Ignores furnace heat; can carry a crucible

chrysalis_warden.description: A cocoon that never quite hatches. It absorbs one fatal mistake per cycle and remembers it.

chemistry_bonuses.description: Once per session, prevents a fatal laboratory accident
